duration.text: The Long-Term Practical Chinese Course at Shanghai Maritime University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 916 USD/per semester ￥ 6600 CNY/per semester

requirements.text: 1.Applicants should be between the age of 16 to 60 2.Applicants must Be in good health
